newsitem.title: USA: Lone Star Technologies calls debentures.
newsitem.headline: Lone Star Technologies calls debentures.

text.p: Lone Star Technologies Inc said on Monday it has called for redemption on August 28, 1997 the entire $50 million principal amount of its 8 percent convertible subordinated debentures due 2002.
The redemption price is 100 percent of the principal amount, the company said in a statement.

All interest due on that date will be paid on all redeemed debentures and on debentures converted into common stock on August 27 or August 28, 1997 if the appropriate coupons are surrendered, the company said.
The debentures can be converted into LST Common Stock at a conversion price of $24.25 per share, the company said.
Lone Star's shares closed 32-1/16, up 1/16, on July 28.
The redemption will reduce its interest costs by $4 million annually while reducing its debt to total capitalization ratio, Lone Star said.
